_doc: Authored intent phrasings. The AiConnect gateway folds these into its BM25 search haystack only - never into what the model is shown, and never into the embedding.
_rule: An alias must not introduce a word that is COMMON in ordinary English but RARE in the corpus. BM25 IDF treats such a word as maximally discriminating, so it becomes a magnet for queries the tool should refuse. Name the OPERATION - not a material, a trade, or any everyday noun. Authored from each tool's own name and description only, never from the benchmark task prompts.
